mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned El Tigre silver-gold project, Sonora, Mexico. Stockwork Zone PFS (Nov 2024, NI 43-101): 10-yr open-pit life; 43M payable AgEq oz (510k AuEq: 9M oz Ag + 408k oz Au); avg 4.8M AgEq oz/yr (56.7k AuEq/yr); base case ($26/oz Ag, $2,150/oz Au): after-tax NPV5% US$222M, IRR 40%, payback 2.0 yrs; spot: NPV >US$380M, IRR 60%, payback 1.5 yrs; undiscounted after-tax CF US$318M. Initial capex $86.8M (incl $9.3M contingency); expansion capex $20.1M (yr 3); sustaining capex $6.2M LOM; LOM cash costs $973/oz AuEq; AISC $1,214/oz AuEq ($12/oz AgEq cash, $14/oz AgEq AISC). MRE: 200 Moz AgEq @ 92 g/t AgEq M&I; 84 Moz AgEq @ 180 g/t AgEq inferred. First 3 yrs primarily Proven reserves (starter pit, 0.3:1 strip). Updated PFS filed Jan 2026 (at $38/oz Ag, $3,200/oz Au): after-tax NPV US$456M, IRR 65.7%, same $86.8M capex. Company holds 800 tpd underground permit; open-pit amendment filed. No production.

Preliminary Economic Assessment (filed Jan 2026) for second-phase underground mining of high-grade El Tigre/Sulphide/Black Shale/Seitz Kelly veins + historic tailings reprocessing, stand-alone of the open pit. Base case ($38/oz Ag, $3,200/oz Au): after-tax NPV5% US$304M, IRR 42.8%, payback 2.6 yrs; undiscounted after-tax CF US$496M. 15-yr UG life + 3 yrs tailings reprocessing; 38M payable AgEq oz (453k AuEq: 34M oz Ag + 130k oz Au); avg ~2.3M AgEq oz/yr. Initial capex $83.5M (incl $10.9M contingency), 18-month build; sustaining capex $213M LOM. No production.

notes: Developer; no FY2025 production or revenue. TSX-V:SLVR, OTCQX:SLVTF. President & CEO Glenn Jessome. All economics in USD. Path to 5+ Moz/yr Ag production by 2027 targeted; construction estimated 18 months from permitting.
